title: Belle Isle Beach & Sunset Summer Tour with Private Transportation
includes: Downtown Detroit hotel pickup and drop-off
Time for waterfront relaxation and photography
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries

cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience a relaxing summer escape to Belle Isle Park, Detroit’s scenic island destination located in the Detroit River. This private tour offers a comfortable way to enjoy the beauty of Detroit’s waterfront with a dedicated guide-driver providing transportation and local insights throughout the experience.
Your journey begins with pickup from your downtown Detroit hotel, followed by a scenic drive to Belle Isle, including views of the Detroit River, the city skyline, and Windsor, Canada. Spend your time at Belle Isle Beach enjoying the summer atmosphere, relaxing by the water, swimming in the designated beach area when conditions allow, walking along the shoreline, and capturing memorable photos.
End your visit at a beautiful waterfront viewpoint, where you can enjoy panoramic river views and a peaceful summer sunset before your guide-driver returns you to your hotel.
